question.text: The Compliance Officer must provide an Independent Report to SEBI on any non-compliance by the AIF:

answer.text: At the end of the financial year
Within 7 working days from observing such non-compliance

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per the 2023 amendment, the Compliance Officer must provide an independent report to SEBI immediately or within 7 working days from observing non-compliance. **The Trap:** Year-end reporting or reactive-only reporting is not permitted. **Cross-Exam Context:** Consistent with Broker/Depository CO obligations under III-A/VI. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Maintain a non-compliance register internally so the 7-day report is backed by documentation.
